title: 2026 African Youth Policy & Futures Fellowship
summary: Join 40 high-performing young policy researchers formulating legislative briefs and futures scenarios across 18 African member states.
description: Fellows receive intensive training in predictive policy analytics, participatory governance, and direct placement with ministerial and African Union advisory councils.
eligibility: African nationals aged 21–32 with bachelor's or equivalent experience in public policy, economics, statistics, or community development.

title: CivicTech Seed Innovation Grant 2026
summary: Catalytic funding and prototyping support for young African founders building tech solutions that enhance civic accountability, climate resilience, or public service access.
description: Selected startups enter our 6-month venture lab with access to user testing labs, government data sandboxes, and follow-on investor syndicates.
eligibility: Teams with majority founders aged 18–35 possessing a functioning MVP in AgriTech, CleanTech, GovTech, or HealthTech.

title: East African Circular Economy Design Challenge
summary: A 10-week human-centered design challenge for grassroots teams solving urban plastic recycling and decentralized organic waste processing.
description: Teams co-design directly with informal waste-picker associations and city council environmental officers to test scalable decentralized circular models.
eligibility: Open to cross-disciplinary teams of 2–4 young people residing in Kenya, Uganda, Tanzania, or Rwanda.

title: Call for Papers: African Youth Economic Futures Journal
benefit: $1,500 Honorarium per Accepted Paper + Open-Access Indexing
summary: Inviting empirical research manuscripts authored by African scholars under 35 examining informal market digitization, green job pathways, and AI governance.
description: Selected papers will be published in AfriYouth's peer-reviewed policy journal and presented at the 2027 Africa Youth Foresight Summit in Addis Ababa.
eligibility: Primary authors under 35 affiliated with an African research institution, university, think tank, or independent research collective.

title: Southern Africa Climate Adaptation Lab 2026
summary: Community-led adaptation residency designing drought-resilient smallholder farming strategies in Southern African river basins.
description: Cohort completed onboarding and is currently deployed in Limpopo and Gaza provinces conducting participatory vulnerability mapping.
eligibility: Closed for current cycle. Next intake opens July 2027.

title: Pan-African Youth Governance Advisory Council
benefit: Direct Consultation Seat at Regional Economic Desks
summary: 12-month appointment for exceptional youth civic leaders providing youth-proofing advisory on regional integration agreements.
description: Council members represent regional youth constituencies across ECOWAS, EAC, SADC, and ECCAS.
eligibility: Applications currently closed. Join our newsletter to receive the 2027 call notification.
